z-m-35-02.s.s2.prompt: Usebenzisa igama elithi 'isibonelo esiphikisayo', chazela umngane ukuthi kungani u-'uma p khona-ke q' kuthathwa njengeqiniso uma kungekho nto nhlobo efeza p. Engeza futhi esinye isibonelo somumo ofanayo (umbandela ngezinombolo).
z-m-35-02.s.s2.hint.0: Qala ubhale ngomusho owodwa ukuthi kumele kube nento enjani ukuze u-'uma p khona-ke q' abe yiphutha.
z-m-35-02.s.s2.hint.1: Yenza umbandela owodwa (ngezinombolo) ongekho nto efeza p, bese uhlola ukuthi isitatimende esithi lowo nto kumele ibe khona siyasebenza yini.
z-m-35-02.s.s2.placeholder: Isibonelo: Ukuze kube yiphutha kumele kube ..., kodwa ...
z-m-35-02.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ingabe ngiqale ngathi 'yini eyodwa okumele ibe khona ukuze kube yiphutha'?
z-m-35-02.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ingabe ngixhumanise ukuthi kungani leyo nto ingenakubakhona neqiniso lokuthi akukho nto efeza p?
z-m-35-02.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ingabe isibonelo engisengezile ngempela siyisimo okungekho nombolo efeza p kuso?
z-m-35-02.s.s2.model.0: Ukuthi iyiqiniso noma iyiphutha kunqunywa ukuthi ikhona yini isibonelo esiphikisayo. Uma kungekho ngisho nomfundi oyedwa onobude obungu-190 cm noma ngaphezulu, akunakubakhona umfundi onjalo ongasebenzisi igumbi lokufunda B, okungukuthi, akukho sibonelo esiphikisayo, ngakho ayikwazi ukubizwa ngephutha, ngakho ngiyibheka njengeqiniso. Njengesibonelo somumo ofanayo, 'uma x iyinombolo yangempela futhi x²<0, khona-ke x>5' nayo ayinayo inombolo yangempela ene-x²<0, ngakho akukho sibonelo esiphikisayo, ngakho iyiqiniso.
z-m-35-02.s.s2.model.1: Ukuze "uma p khona-ke q" ibe yiphutha, kumele kube necala elilodwa okungenani lapho p iyiqiniso futhi q ayilungile. Kodwa uma kungekho cala nhlobo elifeza p, isibonelo esiphikisayo esinjalo asikwazi ukuba khona, ngakho iyiqiniso. Isibonelo, "uma x² < 0 enombolweni yangempela x, khona-ke x > 5" nayo iyiqiniso ngoba ayikho x yangempela ene-x² < 0. Ngokwamasethi, kuyindaba efanayo nokuthi isethi engenalutho iyingxenye yanoma yiyiphi isethi.

z-m-35-04.prereq.0: I-H1 yalo msebenzi ilebula yobunzima ebhetshini lokukhiqiza kuphela, hhayi ukubekwa kwebanga ohlelweni lokufunda. z-m-35-04.title: Uma inani elilodwa lingekho kusethi
z-m-35-04.topic: Isethi yeqiniso yesimo nenani lomkhawulo (ukuthi kukhona uphawu lokulingana yini)
z-m-35-04.goal: Hlola lapho inani lomkhawulo lingena khona kusethi yeqiniso yesimo se-inequality ukuhlulela ukuthi u-'noma' uhlala eyiqiniso yini, bese wakha amacala amaningana wena anelisa imikhawulo enikeziwe esimweni lapho indawo yophawu lokulingana iguqukile.
z-m-35-04.material: Kunombolo engempela u-x, setha izimo nezethi zeqiniso zazo kanje. [가] p: x<a, q: x>b. [나] p: x<a, q: x≥b. Lapha u-a no-b bangokungaguquki, futhi u-P no-Q yizethi zeqiniso zika-p no-q ngokulandelana. UMinjae waxazulula icala lika-a=b=3 ku-[가] kanje. (Indlela yokufunda: ≥ isho 'inkulu noma ilingana,' no-x<a usho 'u-x mncane kuno-a'.)
z-m-35-04.prereq.1: Ukukhombisa izethi zeqiniso ze-inequality u-x<a no-x≥b emugqeni wezinombolo
z-m-35-04.prereq.2: Ukuthi isethi yeqiniso yesimo u-'p noma q' ngu-P∪Q
z-m-35-04.s.s1.prompt: Umugqa wokuqala esixazululweni sikaMinjae lapho ukucabanga kuphutha ungaphi? Bala izinombolo zemigqa kusukela ku-1.
z-m-35-04.s.s1.hint.0: Usebenzisa u-p no-q abasethwe emgqeni 1, hlukanisa inombolo engempela ngayinye ngokuthi ingeka-p noma ka-q.
z-m-35-04.s.s1.hint.1: Cabanga ukuthi yimaphi ama-x afakiwe ku-"kuwo wonke inombolo engempela u-x," bese uhlola umugqa ngomugqa ukuthi umugqa ngamunye uphathe wonke lawo ma-x yini.
z-m-35-04.s.s1.line.0: Ake u-a=b=3. Bese u-p ungu-x<3 no-q ungu-x>3.
z-m-35-04.s.s1.line.1: Uma u-x emncane kuno-3, u-p uyiqiniso, futhi uma u-x emkhulu kuno-3, u-q uyiqiniso.
z-m-35-04.s.s1.line.2: Icala lika-x=3 alincane noma likhulu kuno-3, ngakho alikho kunoma yiluphi uhlangothi futhi asidingi ukulicabangela ngokuhlukile.
z-m-35-04.s.s1.line.3: Ngakho, kuwo wonke izinombolo ezingempela u-x, u-'p noma q' uyiqiniso.
z-m-35-04.s.s1.explain: Inkinga ukuthi emgqeni 3 uqobo usho ukuthi u-x=3 akekho kunoma yisiphi isimo bese ethi 'asidingi ukulicabangela ngokuhlukile'. U-'wonke izinombolo ezingempela u-x' ufaka no-x=3, futhi uma kokubili u-p no-q bengamanga ku-x=3, khona-ke u-'p noma q' uyamanga, ngakho ku-[가] awukwazi ukusho ukuthi uma u-a=b iyiqiniso kuzo zonke izinombolo ezingempela. Isiphetho emgqeni 4 siphosile ngenxa yomugqa 3.
z-m-35-04.s.s2.prompt: Manje, ku-[나] (p: x<a, q: x≥b), yenza amapheya (a, b) angu-3 ahlukile anelisa konke okulandelayo. (i) 'p noma q' iyiqiniso kuzo zonke izinombolo ezingempela u-x. (ii) Kunezinombolo eziphelele u-x ezingu-2 ncamashi ezanelisa u-p no-q ngasikhathi sinye. U-a no-b bangaba ama-decimal.
z-m-35-04.s.s2.hint.0: Dweba u-P no-Q emugqeni wezinombolo bese unquma ukuthi u-b no-a kumele babe kuphi ukuze bahlangane ngaphandle kwesikhala.
z-m-35-04.s.s2.hint.1: Lisitha izinombolo eziphelele esikhawini kusuka ku-b kuze kube ngaphambi kuka-a, bese ulungisa u-a no-b ukuze kube ngu-2 ncamashi.
z-m-35-04.s.s2.fail.c1: Uma u-b emkhulu kuno-a, izinombolo kusuka ku-a kuze kube ngaphambi kuka-b azanelisi u-p noma u-q.
z-m-35-04.s.s2.ok.c2: Kunezinombolo eziphelele ezingu-2 ncamashi kusuka ku-b kuze kube ngaphambi kuka-a (isimo (ii)).
z-m-35-04.s.s2.fail.c2: Inani lezinombolo eziphelele kusuka ku-b kuze kube ngaphambi kuka-a alisilo u-2.
z-m-35-04.s.s2.explain: Ku-[나], u-P ungaphansi kuka-a no-Q ungu-b noma ngaphezulu. Ukuze i-union ibe yizinombolo ezingempela zonke, u-b≤a uyadingeka, futhi izinombolo ezanelisa kokubili ngasikhathi sinye yilezo kusuka ku-b kuze kube ngaphambi kuka-a. Kwanele ukuthi kube nezinombolo eziphelele ezingu-2 ncamashi lapho, ngakho isibonelo u-(3,1) uqukethe u-1, 2, u-(2.5,0.5) uqukethe u-1, 2, no-(4.2,2.3) uqukethe u-3, 4. Uma u-b=a, azikho izinombolo ezigqagqanayo nhlobo, ngakho (ii) ayanelisiwe.
z-m-35-04.s.s2.because.prompt: Chaza ukuthi u-P no-Q bahlobana kanjani ku-[나] uma u-b=a, nokuthi lokho kuhluke kanjani esizathini sokuthi u-a=b ofanayo wawuyinkinga ku-[가].
z-m-35-04.s.s2.because.hint.0: Setha u-a=b=3 bese ufaka u-x=3 ku-p no-q we-[나], bese ubhala ukuthi ngamunye uyiqiniso noma amanga.
z-m-35-04.s.s2.because.hint.1: Qhathanisa nokufaka u-x=3 ofanayo ku-p no-q we-[가].
z-m-35-04.s.s2.because.placeholder: Isibonelo: Ku-[나], u-x=a ungena ku-... ngakho ...
z-m-35-04.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ngisho ukuthi u-x=a ungena kusethi iyiphi, ngokuhlukile ku-[나] nku-[가]?
z-m-35-04.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ngikhombile ukuthi u-P no-Q bayizinsimbi komunye nomunye noma ukuthi azikho izinombolo ezigqagqanayo?
z-m-35-04.s.s2.because.model.0: Ku-[나], uma u-a=b, u-P ungaphansi kuka-a no-Q ungu-a noma ngaphezulu, ngakho u-x=a ungena ku-Q. Ngakho i-union iyizinombolo ezingempela zonke, futhi akukho x ogqagqanayo, ngakho bayizinsimbi komunye nomunye. Ku-[가], u-q akanawo uphawu lokulingana, ngakho u-x=a awungeni ku-P noma ku-Q.
z-m-35-04.s.s2.because.model.1: Okuhlukile ukuthi ubani othola inani lomkhawulo u-x=a. Ku-[나], u-q 'mkhulu noma ulingana', ngakho ufaka u-a futhi akukho sikhala, kodwa [가] 'mkhulu kuno', ngakho u-a uyashiywa. Ngakho ku-[가], noma u-a=b, akuhlali kuyiqiniso.
z-m-35-04.s.s2.because.model.2: Ku-[나], uma u-b=a, u-P ungu-x<a no-Q ungu-x≥a, ngakho behlukanisa zonke izinombolo ezingempela ngaphandle kokugqagqana, kodwa ku-[가], u-x=3 akekho ku-P noma ku-Q, ngakho i-union akuyona izinombolo ezingempela zonke.

z-m-35-05.prereq.0: I-H1 yalo msebenzi ilebula yobunzima ebhetshini lokukhiqiza kuphela, hhayi ukubekwa kwebanga ohlelweni lokufunda. z-m-35-05.title: Imisho emibili enamagama afanayo ngokulandelana okuhlukile: ingabe isho into efanayo?
z-m-35-05.topic: Ukulandelana ezindabeni ezinakho kokubili u-'wonke' no-'abanye'
z-m-35-05.goal: Sebenzisa ithebula ukuhlola ukuthi imisho emibili ehluka ngokulandelana kuka-'kuwo wonke ... kukhona' no-'othile ... wonke' ayilandelani, bese uthola ukuxhumana okuphosile futhi ukuchaze ngesibonelo esiphikisayo.
z-m-35-05.material: Abafundi abane 가, 나, 다, 라 bathumelelana amanothi okugqugquzela. Akekho othumele kuyena uqobo. Umugqa ngamunye wethebula ngu-'umthumeli → abamukeli'. [Ithebula 1] 가→나, 다, 라 / 나→다 / 다→나 / 라→다. [Ithebula 2] 가→나 / 나→다 / 다→라 / 라→가. Isitatimende ㄱ: Kumfundi ngamunye, kukhona umfundi othumele inothi kuyena. Isitatimende ㄴ: Omunye umfundi othumele inothi kubo bonke abanye.
z-m-35-05.prereq.1: Incazelo ye-'kuwo wonke u-x' ne-'kukhona u-x onjalo'
z-m-35-05.s.s1.hint.0: Funda ithebula ngomugqa womthumeli we-ㄴ, nommukeli oyedwa ngesikhathi we-ㄱ.
z-m-35-05.s.s1.hint.1: Ukuhlola u-ㄱ, bhala eyodwa ngesikhathi ukuthi kukhona yini umfundi othumele ku-가, 나, 다, 라 ngamunye.
z-m-35-05.s.s1.r.a: Ku-ㄱ kumele uhlolisise uhlangothi 'lokwamukela' lomfundi ngamunye. Funda ithebula ngokuqondile bese uhlola ukuthi kukhona yini umfundi ongatholanga lutho kunoma ubani.
z-m-35-05.s.s1.r.b: Hlola ukuthi izitatimende ezimbili zifunda ithebula ngesiqondiso esifanayo yini. U-ㄱ ubheka uhlangothi lokwamukela, no-ㄴ ubheka uhlangothi lokuthumela.
z-m-35-05.s.s1.r.c: Lapho uhlola u-ㄴ, bheka umugqa ngomugqa ukuthi umugqa owodwa ufaka bonke abafundi abathathu abanye yini.
z-m-35-05.s.s1.r.d: Lo ngumphumela wokuhlola, emgqeni womthumeli, ukuthi umfundi oyedwa wathumela kubo bonke abanye yini, nokuhlola ngokuhlukile, ohlangothini lokwamukela, ukuthi umfundi ngamunye wathola yini.
z-m-35-05.s.s1.explain: Ku-[Ithebula 1], 가 wathumela ku-나, 다, 라 bonke, ngakho u-ㄴ uyiqiniso. Kodwa akekho othumele inothi ku-가, ngakho u-ㄱ ungamanga.
z-m-35-05.s.s2.prompt: UHarin wathi u-ㄴ naye uyiqiniso ku-[Ithebula 2] futhi wachaza njengaphansi. Ngumugqa muphi owokuqala lapho ukucabanga kuphutha? Izinombolo zemigqa zibalwa kusukela ku-1.
z-m-35-05.s.s2.hint.0: Ku-[Ithebula 2], hlola umugqa ngomugqa ukuthi umugqa ka-가 ufaka bonke abafundi abathathu abanye yini.
z-m-35-05.s.s2.hint.1: Qhathanisa nomusho ka-ㄴ iphuzu lokuthi ku-ㄱ, 'umthumeli' wabafundi ngabanye ungaba ngumfundi ofanayo noma ohlukile.
z-m-35-05.s.s2.line.0: Ku-[Ithebula 2], 가 wathumela ku-나, 나 wathumela ku-다, 다 wathumela ku-라, no-라 wathumela ku-가.
z-m-35-05.s.s2.line.1: Ngokubheka uhlangothi lokwamukela, ngamunye ka-가, 나, 다, 라 wathola inothi kanye, ngakho u-ㄱ uyiqiniso.
z-m-35-05.s.s2.line.2: Ukuthi umfundi ngamunye uthole inothi kusho ukuthi kukhona umthumeli komfundi ngamunye, ngakho kulandela ukuthi umfundi oyedwa wathumela kubo bonke abanye abafundi.
z-m-35-05.s.s2.explain: Kuze kube umugqa 2 kulungile (u-ㄱ uyiqiniso ku-[Ithebula 2]). z-m-35-06.title: Ukwakha wena izimo ezimbili ezinenani elilodwa lezibonelo eziphikisayo
z-m-35-06.topic: Ukubala izibonelo eziphikisayo zesiphakamiso esithi 'uma u-p khona-ke u-q' kanye nesiphakamiso sokuphambana saso (ukufakwa kwezethi zeqiniso)
z-m-35-06.goal: Sebenzisa iqiniso lokuthi umehluko wezethi zeqiniso uyisethi yezibonelo eziphikisayo ukuklama wena izimo ezimbili ezanelisa imikhawulo yenani lezibonelo eziphikisayo, bese uqhathanisa izixazululo eziningana.
z-m-35-06.material: Ngesethi eyisiyonke u-U={1, 2, 3, …, 12}, cabanga ngezimo ezimbili u-p: x≥a, q: x≤b. U-a no-b bayizinombolo eziphelele kusuka ku-1 kuya ku-12, futhi u-P no-Q yizethi zeqiniso zika-p no-q ngokulandelana. Isibonelo esiphikisayo sesiphakamiso esithi 'uma u-p khona-ke u-q' yinto ye-U lapho u-p eyiqiniso no-q engamanga, futhi isibonelo esiphikisayo sesiphakamiso saso sokuphambana 'uma u-q khona-ke u-p' yinto lapho u-q eyiqiniso no-p engamanga. (Indlela yokufunda: u-x≥a ngu-'x ungu-a okungenani,' no-x≤b ngu-'x ungu-b ubuningi'.)
z-m-35-06.s.s1.prompt: Yiluphi olukhombisa kangcono izibonelo eziphikisayo zesiphakamiso esithi 'uma u-p khona-ke u-q' usebenzisa izethi zeqiniso u-P no-Q?
z-m-35-06.s.s1.hint.0: Khetha into eyodwa noma ezimbili ze-U wena ezifanelana nencazelo yesibonelo esiphikisayo ('isimo u-p siyiqiniso kodwa isiphetho u-q singamanga').
z-m-35-06.s.s1.hint.1: Bhala ukuthi leyo nto ingeka-P noma ka-Q nokuthi ayiyona eyiphi.
z-m-35-06.s.s1.r.a: Uguqulele incazelo yesibonelo esiphikisayo, 'u-p uyiqiniso kodwa u-q ungamanga,' olimini lwamasethi.
z-m-35-06.s.s1.r.b: Lezi zinto yizona eziphula 'uma u-q khona-ke u-p'. Bheka futhi iqiniso lokuthi isibonelo esiphikisayo yinto lapho 'uhlangothi lwesimo luyiqiniso futhi uhlangothi lwesiphetho lungamanga'.
z-m-35-06.s.s1.r.c: Into lapho kokubili u-p no-q beyiqiniso ayiphuli 'uma u-p khona-ke u-q' futhi empeleni iyasekela. Qhathanisa nencazelo yesibonelo esiphikisayo.
z-m-35-06.s.s1.r.d: Qhathanisa nencazelo yesibonelo esiphikisayo ukuthi into lapho kokubili u-p no-q bengamanga inendima muni ku-'uma u-p khona-ke u-q'.
z-m-35-06.s.s1.explain: Isibonelo esiphikisayo ku-'uma u-p khona-ke u-q' yinto lapho u-p eyiqiniso no-q engamanga, okungukuthi, into engeka-P futhi engeyona eka-Q, ngakho kungu-P−Q (=P∩Qᶜ). Isibonelo esiphikisayo esiphakamisweni sokuphambana 'uma u-q khona-ke u-p' ngu-Q−P.
